response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but their profile diverges significantly from this role's mandatory requirements. C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments (2014–2015) and academic projects — far short of the required 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++. There is no Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking domain experience (RIDE Capital was a retail investment startup using Node/TypeScript), and no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle depth. Only peripheral desirables (CI/CD, some Java, scripting) are covered.
strengths: Broad, senior-level engineering experience across web, backend, and systems programming
Solid CI/CD, testing (TDD), and DevOps practices demonstrated across multiple roles
Experience with low-latency, high-throughput systems (DLang at Dunnhumby)
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ experience, and none recent or on Windows
No Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking domain exposure
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle experience (MySQL/MongoDB only)

key_factors.factor: No capital markets / fixed income domain knowledge
